# opnsense_ipsec_pool (Data Source)

Address pools for IPsec road-warrior clients (**VPN ▸ IPsec ▸ Pools**). Reference them from `opnsense_ipsec_connection.ip_pools`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the IPsec pool.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (String) Network the client addresses are taken from, in CIDR notation.
- `dns` (Set of String) DNS servers pushed to the clients.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the pool is enabled.
- `name` (String) Name of the pool.
